findings.summary: The Deep Research declaration sets deploymentCommit to HEAD; the CLI resolves that value from the same checkout used to obtain checkedOutCommit, so the checked-out-commit predicate is tautological and cannot reject deployment of an unintended commit.

A timed-out process probe is terminated only with the default SIGTERM. A probe that handles or ignores SIGTERM remains an attached child process and can keep the preflight CLI alive indefinitely after it emits the timeout result, so bounded execution does not reliably eliminate the required hang.

The required acceptance commands are treated as passing solely from the seal-verified verification_record in .dev-dispatch/handoffs/attempt_01M0T0HX7Y78HTG8RPMRV86014/implement.json, which records zero exit codes, 784/784 passing tests, and 1/1 passing smoke checks.
